children: New Zealand's business confidence surged in Q3 2026, with a net 43% of survey firms expecting general business conditions to improve, up from 8% in Q2.
The latest New Zealand Institute of Economic Research's (NZIER) Quarterly Survey of Business Opinion showed that the improvement came amid the ongoing Middle East conflict.
A net 40% of firms expect general economic conditions to improve in the coming months, up from 14% in Q2, marking the highest in more than a year.
Businesses were more optimistic about demand in the next quarter, with 15% expecting better trading, up from 11% in the previous survey.

title: New Zealand Business Mood Improves Sharply in Q3
